enable_p4_b_legacy_score_isolation.hint: Disabled by default for compatibility. When enabled, legacy relationship_score writes are suppressed and never become P4 authority.

enable_group_cycle_awareness.description: Allow minimal Bot cycle tone boundary in permitted groups
enable_group_cycle_awareness.hint: Disabled by default. Reads only the Bot simulated state to pace replies. It never records user health facts or private body details from group chats.

allow_generate_photo_on_reaction_turns.description: Keep the photo tool on reaction-expression authorized turns
allow_generate_photo_on_reaction_turns.hint: Disabled by default to preserve the original behavior that ordinary casual chat does not expose the image tool to the main model. When enabled, an authorized reaction-expression turn (not an explicit media request) still keeps pc_generate_photo in the request tool declaration, so the model can answer colloquial see-photo/selfie/showing requests; without an explicit request it must still only write text or the hidden expression tag and must not generate proactively. pc_find_reaction_image and pc_send_current_media stay scoped out on authorized turns; quotas and daily caps still apply.
